caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair with a curved frame and scroll-like details at the base of the rockers and armrests. The chair’s frame is rendered in a brown color, suggesting wood grain. Both the seat and the backrest are upholstered with a fabric featuring a colorful floral pattern. The pattern contains large blue and red flowers, with green and white leaves, set against an off-white background. The rest of the drawing is on a plain, beige background without additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Toy Chair
